column1: national-palace-museum|9.3,9.6,9.8,9.2,9.3|-|Unusually rich imperial art collection and cultural significance, but core visitor impact is not automatically above every great palace/museum worldwide.
taroko-national-park|9.5,9.5,9.1,9.3,9.4|-|Extraordinary marble gorge and high mountain system; avoid overlapping every Taroko Gorge component into park depth without distinction.
taroko-gorge|9.4,9.5,9.0,9.2,8.6|-|Spectacular specific marble gorge, with less independent exploration breadth than the entire Taroko National Park.

alishan-national-forest-recreation-area|9.2,9.3,8.6,9.0,9.1|-|Excellent giant-tree forests and cloudscapes, though one recreation area should not inherit the historic rail system or entire Alishan region.

alishan-forest-railway|8.7,9.0,8.9,8.7,8.2|history=9.2|Major scenic mountain-railway engineering and forest ride, but short railway experience should be benchmarked against Semmering Railway rather than Angkor-scale heritage.
yushan-main-peak|9.3,9.2,9.0,9.0,8.4|-|National high point offers major alpine challenge; peak viewpoint/trek is narrower than all Yushan National Park habitats.
yushan-national-park|9.2,9.3,9.0,9.0,9.2|-|Major high-elevation habitats and trekking range, without transferring each mountain summit's unique merit to every dimension.
shei-pa-national-park|9.1,9.2,8.7,8.8,9.0|-|Outstanding mountain and forest reserve, with slightly less global historical/scientific singularity than the top reference parks.
fo-guang-shan-buddha-museum|8.9,8.9,8.6,9.0,8.9|-|Monumental modern Buddhist complex and engaging museum, but its age and global heritage status differ from Angkor or ancient temples.
taipei-101|9.0,8.8,8.1,9.0,8.0|-|Iconic modern engineering and city view, but a single skyscraper visit has limited depth and less global historical significance.
xueshan-main-peak|8.9,8.9,8.5,8.9,8.3|-|High mountain climb and scenery, with much less diverse discovery than all of Shei-Pa National Park.
hehuanshan-mountain-area|8.9,8.7,8.1,8.9,8.3|-|Accessible alpine panoramas and hiking, but neither uniqueness nor historical significance equals globally singular mountain parks.
beigang-chaotian-temple|8.7,8.9,9.0,8.7,8.2|-|Major Taiwanese pilgrimage temple but less singular globally than much larger surviving sacred ensembles.
penghu-islands|8.8,9.0,8.4,8.9,8.8|-|Significant island group and basalt coast, while individual island sites should not inherit whole-archipelago exploration depth.
green-island|8.7,8.9,8.2,8.8,8.4|-|Valuable marine habitat and modern historical sites, without treating island size as worldwide uniqueness.
yehliu-geopark|8.9,9.1,8.5,8.9,8.1|-|Striking sea-eroded rock formations with memorable visit, but contained geopark depth below vast natural landscapes.
